title: Add or change an operation in the SDK (contract first)
caption: What a fix that touches the API surface must do so CI stays green (CLAUDE.md rule 3, README §6). The contract files under docs/velexis-sdk/sdk/src/ are never edited.

steps.title: Change the OpenAPI document
steps.body: Edit `ota/backend/openapi/velexis-ota-booking-api.openapi.yaml`: the operation with its `x-sdk-method` (dotted name), `x-scope`, `x-permission`, `x-error-codes`, `x-tenant-tables`, and `x-idempotent-by-design` where a POST is safe to repeat. Regenerate the API types (`pnpm contracts:generate` or the api-types build).
steps.expect: The document lints; `@velexis/api-types` has the new schemas.

steps.title: Regenerate the route table
steps.body: `pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-sdk generate`. Long operations or `retry: never` need an entry with a `reason` in `scripts/operation-overrides.json`.
steps.expect: `src/internal/operations.js` and `test/contract/methods.generated.ts` change; the parity test now fails until the method exists.

steps.title: Write the one-line method with JSDoc
steps.body: In `src/namespaces/<ns>.js`: `name: (params, options) => core.call(op.<ns>_<name>, params, live(options))` with `@param`, `@returns` and one `@throws` per class of the operation's `x-error-codes` (and the generic refusals it lists). Use `requireIfMatch` when the operation requires `If-Match`.

steps.title: Test it
steps.body: Add a case to `test/unit/namespaces-<ns>.test.js` with the fake fetch: method, path, query, headers (Idempotency-Key, If-Match, X-Velexis-Environment) and body.

steps.title: Document it
steps.body: An MVP addition goes into `ota/sdk/docs/extensions.md` §3; add a line to `CHANGELOG.md`; update counts in `README.md` §1 and §5.2.
steps.expect: `pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-sdk build` stays under 25 KB; the bundle test passes.
